name: Energy Drink
desc: A quick burst of motivation in a bottle! Instantly adds +500 steps to your daily total, helping you reach your next discovery faster. Use it when you’re just short of finding your next monster.

name: Monster Bait
desc: Smells weird. Works wonders. Toss this out and watch a monster come running — your next search is guaranteed to find something wild!

name: Lucky Charm
desc: Infused with faint monster magic, this charm hums with fortune. For your next search, your chances of encountering rare and legendary monsters are doubled. Sometimes a little luck goes a long way.
